# Token permissions

Edgewatch only reads. The simplest token is Cloudflare's **Read all resources** template, which covers almost everything below.
Two sources need more:

- **Account API tokens** need *Account API Tokens Read*, which the template doesn't include.
- **Logpush jobs** can only be listed with a write permission, so Edgewatch doesn't list them; it reads Logpush health from GraphQL analytics instead.

A source the token can't read shows up under **Scans → Data coverage** with the permission it needs, and the checks that depend on it are
skipped rather than passed. The setup screen tests a token against each source before you connect it.

| Source | Permission | Checks that read it |

| Account settings | Account · Account Settings · Read | IAM-005 |
| Account members | Account · Account Settings · Read | IAM-001, IAM-002, IAM-003, IAM-004 |
| Audit logs | Account · Account Settings · Read | CHG-001, CHG-002, CHG-003 |
| Account API tokens | Account · Account API Tokens · Read | IAM-006, IAM-007, IAM-008, IAM-009 |
| Subscriptions | Account · Billing · Read | Plan detection and the Value page |
| Security Center insights | Account · Security Center Insights · Read | Imported Security Center insights |
| Notifications | Account · Notifications · Read | MON-001, MON-003 |
| Access applications | Account · Access: Apps and Policies · Read | ZT-001, ZT-002, ZT-003, ZT-013, ZT-014, ZT-015, PLT-004, MON-004, ATS-003, ATS-004 |

These sources aren't Cloudflare API reads and need no permission:

- Public DNS lookups
- Takeover probes
